concepts.title: 正切、余切及倒数函数图像
concepts.summary: 渐近线由原三角函数的零点决定；伸缩和平移改变周期和位置。 对 $y=af[b(x-c)]+d$，当 $a\ne0,b\ne0$ 时，$\tan,\cot$ 的周期为 $\pi/|b|$，$\sec,\csc$ 的周期为 $2\pi/|b|$。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 化成 $af(b(x-c))+d$，算周期、渐近线和关键点。

method.title: 渐近线
method.body: 对非零参数，$\tan,\sec$ 的渐近线为 $x=c+(\pi/2+k\pi)/b$；$\cot,\csc$ 的渐近线为 $x=c+k\pi/b$，$k\in\mathbb Z$。

pitfalls: 零参数不适用这些图像公式，须回到原式检查数值及定义域；即使 $a=0$，原三角函数的禁值仍不能消去。

en.title: Tangent, cotangent, and reciprocal graphs
en.summary: Zeros of the original trigonometric function locate reciprocal asymptotes; scaling and translation set the period and position. For $y=af[b(x-c)]+d$, with $a\ne0,b\ne0$, the period is $\pi/|b|$ for $\tan,\cot$ and $2\pi/|b|$ for $\sec,\csc$.

method.title: Method
method.body: Write $af(b(x-c))+d$; calculate the period, asymptotes, and key points.

method.title: Asymptotes
method.body: For nonzero parameters, asymptotes are $x=c+(\pi/2+k\pi)/b$ for $\tan,\sec$, and $x=c+k\pi/b$ for $\cot,\csc$, where $k\in\mathbb Z$.

pitfalls: Zero parameters lie outside these graph formulas; check the original values and domain directly. Even if $a=0$, excluded inputs of the original trigonometric expression remain excluded.

questions.prompt: 一条直线经过 $P=(7,5)$，与正 $x$ 轴的夹角为 $60^\circ$。求斜截式。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $m=\tan(\frac{\pi}{3})=\sqrt{3}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 点斜式为 $y-(5)=\sqrt{3}(x-(7))$。展开并移项得 $y=\sqrt{3}x+(5 - 7 \sqrt{3})$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 代入 $x=7$ 得 $y=5$，核对原点条件。

en.prompt: Find the slope–intercept form of the line through $P=(7,5)$ making an angle $60^\circ$ with the positive $x$-axis.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $m=\tan(\frac{\pi}{3})=\sqrt{3}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Point-slope form is $y-(5)=\sqrt{3}(x-(7))$. Expand and isolate $y$ to obtain $y=\sqrt{3}x+(5 - 7 \sqrt{3})$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Substituting $x=7$ gives $y=5$, verifying the required point.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 令分母为零，得到竖直渐近线 $x=\frac{\pi}{2}+n(\frac{\pi}{2})$，其中 $n\in\mathbb{Z}$；这些点不属于定义域。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 代入基准角，得到关键点 $(\frac{\pi}{8},-3)$, $(\frac{\pi}{4},0)$, $(\frac{3 \pi}{8},3)$。按图中曲线连接，每遇渐近线须分支；周期重复。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 所画区间长为 $\frac{\pi}{2}$，覆盖 1 个周期。值域为 $(-\infty,\infty)$。

en.prompt: Graph $y=3\tan(2x-\pi/2)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Write $y=3\tan[2(x-(\frac{\pi}{4}))]+(0)$. The period is $T=\frac{\pi}{2}$, phase shift is $\frac{\pi}{4}$, and midline is $y=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Set the denominator equal to zero. The vertical asymptotes are $x=\frac{\pi}{2}+n(\frac{\pi}{2})$, $n\in\mathbb{Z}$; exclude these points from the domain.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Substitute the standard arguments to obtain the key points $(\frac{\pi}{8},-3)$, $(\frac{\pi}{4},0)$, $(\frac{3 \pi}{8},3)$. Draw separate branches at each asymptote and repeat with period $T$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The displayed interval has length $\frac{\pi}{2}$ and covers 1 period(s). The range is $(-\infty,\infty)$.

questions.prompt: 马赫数 $M(x)=\csc(x/2)$。作图并求 $x\in[\frac{\pi}{4},\pi)$ 对应的马赫数范围。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 马赫数模型为 $M(x)=v/s=\csc(x/2)$，角度以弧度计。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 在 $\frac{\pi}{4}\le x<\pi$ 上，$\sin(x/2)$ 增大，故 $M$ 减小。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 端点值为 $\csc(\frac{\pi}{8})=\frac{2}{\sqrt{2 - \sqrt{2}}}$ 和 $\csc(\frac{\pi}{2})=1$。按端点开闭得到 $(1,\frac{2}{\sqrt{2 - \sqrt{2}}}]$。

en.prompt: The Mach number is $M(x)=\csc(x/2)$. Graph the function and find its range for $x\in[\frac{\pi}{4},\pi)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The Mach-number model is $M(x)=v/s=\csc(x/2)$, with angles in radians.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: On the given interval, $\sin(x/2)$ increases, so $M$ decreases.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The endpoint values are $\csc(\frac{\pi}{8})=\frac{2}{\sqrt{2 - \sqrt{2}}}$ and $\csc(\frac{\pi}{2})=1$. Respecting the endpoint inclusions gives $(1,\frac{2}{\sqrt{2 - \sqrt{2}}}]$.

exercises.prompt: 求使 $y=\sec(bx)$ 与 $y=\cot(3x)$ 周期相同的 $b$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 余切周期为 $\pi/3$；正割周期为 $2\pi/|b|$。令两者相等得 $|b|=6$。

en.prompt: Find $b$ so that $y=\sec(bx)$ and $y=\cot(3x)$ have the same period.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Cotangent has period $\pi/3$; secant has period $2\pi/|b|$. Equating them gives $|b|=6$.

exercises.prompt: 用倒数函数图像探索：(a) 比较正弦与余割的图像、渐近线和零点；(b) 选择 sec 后比较余弦与相应倒数函数。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) $\csc x=1/\sin x$：正弦零点 $n\pi$ 成为余割渐近线；正弦为 $\pm1$ 时两图相交；余割无零点，符号与正弦相同。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) $\sec x=1/\cos x$：余弦零点 $\pi/2+n\pi$ 成为正割渐近线，在 $\pm1$ 处相交。原题选择 sec 后把第二条曲线写成 csc，为标签笔误；此处说明选择项对应的正割。

exercises.answer: (a) 正弦零点→余割渐近线；(b) 余弦零点→正割渐近线。

en.prompt: Explore reciprocal graphs. (a) Compare sine and cosecant, including asymptotes and zeros. (b) Choose sec and compare cosine with its reciprocal graph.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) $\csc x=1/\sin x$: sine zeros $n\pi$ become cosecant asymptotes; the graphs meet at sine values $\pm1$. Cosecant has no zeros and the same sign as sine.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) $\sec x=1/\cos x$: cosine zeros $\pi/2+n\pi$ become secant asymptotes; the graphs meet at values $\pm1$. The source says csc after selecting sec, a labeling inconsistency; this explanation uses the selected secant.

en.answer: (a) Sine zeros become cosecant asymptotes; (b) cosine zeros become secant asymptotes.
